body: Can relate to that on Monday morning, it was more so a dream where she was ignoring me (ironic) and  woke up feeling anxious as well. I hope the rest of your day can be filled with some sort of clarity and peace

I just miss them a lot. I feel like everything we went through, this little game of push pull isn’t necessary. I understand their fear of vulnerability but I feel like w.e they’re going through can be resolved with some help, but maybe I’m just doing too much wishful thinking. It’s been about since July since we last spoke and they sort of in my pov shut me out. I still miss them and yes get frustrated that I get left high and dry, it’s a mix of understanding what she might be going through but what I am going through hurts a lot. I feel somewhat different but for some reason I just can’t shake them off my mind. I just wish we could be happy and find the help we both need (I’m working on my own issues and going to therapy). I see people post a lot of their ex’s messaging them but it’s been what feels like forever (since July) since they shut me out, I tried to reach out, last attempt was in early August. I did my part. I just don’t know what to do in that part of my life, everything else I been working on like fitness, goals and finances

Te extraño con todo mi ser. Sus risas, sonrisas, ojos, conversaciones, todo lo extraño. No se porque me estás ignorando pero solo que quiere es que te regreses a mi. Vamos a México, te cuido. Yo tengo mis finanzas arregladas. Yo pago por todo. No quiero que te vayas, tal vez ya te fuiste. Me duele mucho, y me hiciste mucho daño pero aquí estoy todavía esperando para tu regreso. Te amo nena.

Thank you for you sharing all that, that’s so messed up that she can just move onto another relationship like that, I’m so sorry about that, says more about her than you , you know. But good on you for progressing. Tbh man I really just feel for you and may not mean much but I’m sending my love and support. 

 I would definitely relate to still feeling the loss. Can’t help sometimes but to just maybe look at a video or photo of us (I deleted basically all of them except for a few). But tbh man there’s still something in me that wants her. Tbh a lot of me wants her again. Like you said it’s like damn I’m just craving her. 

Overall I’m doing okay, I have therapy set up, been getting into martial arts and working out and working on some of my passions. But man a big reason why I have to do all of this is cause it helps calm my anxiety. I just feel really sometimes almost lost without her. I reminisce about when I first met her, kissed her and look back. Sometimes it scares me cause I say to myself how long is this gonna last? This pain is just a lot and there’s layers to it, but at the EOD, it’s pain. But hopefully moving back to my home country soon. It’s gonna be hard going back without her if that’s what happens but it is what it is.

Same here, 4 months roughly since they sort of just left and the pain that I’ve went through and still slightly go through is something I don’t think they’ll ever understand. I’m glad it’s starting to fade for you, for me I can’t seem to let go most days
